cohort: The study included all cases of caesarean hysterectomy performed at PMCH, Patna between January 2022 and December 2023.
finding: The incidence of caesarean hysterectomy was 8.6/1000 deliveries, with ruptured uterus (65.3%) being the most common indication.
mod_finding: Cesarean hysterectomy, a procedure performed during Cesarean delivery, was primarily indicated by ruptured uterus, morbidly adhered placenta, placenta previa, and atonic PPH, highlighting severe complications associated with the mode of birth.
